_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Keneen ak Dealer

📖 TEERE GAME:
• Yow ngone ci {start_chips} chip
• Paakaar buleen 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Yow jëfandikoo ak dealer (kër)
• Kókooroo buleen bu Ultimate Texas Hold'em: yow post ANTE ak BLIND bets, am 2 kaartu hole, tontu ci optional PLAY bets ci biir phaseu yi, baare kaartu community yi, ak ñaare 5-kaartu hand yow jëfandikoo ci dealer.
• Game jàll ci 0 chip walla ci suufu round (LOSS) walla jàll 1000 round ak chip (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet ci kókooroo buleen
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet ci kókooroo buleen
• PLAY: Optional bet ci biir gameplay. Ci biir round, yow am naa ci waayu woon: (${ante4} bu ci PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} bu ci FLOP, walla ${ante} bu ci RIVER. Yow am naa ci fold ci river, baare hand, ak ñaare bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Yow am 2 kaartu face-up (yow hole cards)
• Dealer am 2 kaartu face-down (hidden ci yow)
• 5 kaartu community am face-down initially
• Kaartu community yi baare progressively ci biir phaseu yi

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer am naa ci waayu woon PAIR (2 kaartu bu woon rank) ngone, ci 2 kaartu ci seen hand ak 5 kaartu community.
• Dealer qualification mën naa ci betting outcomes, bu ñu jëllee ci biir.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) walla [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, baare first 3 kaartu community
  • [check]: Ñaare bet, baare first 3 kaartu community

📋 FLOP:
  • Bu 4x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-baare last 2 kaartu community)
  • Bu ñaare 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) walla [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, baare last 2 kaartu community
  • [check]: Ñaare bet, baare last 2 kaartu community

📋 RIVER:
  • Bu 4x walla 2x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-proceeds ci showdown)
  • Bu ñaare prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) walla [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, proceeds ci showdown
  • [fold]: Baare hand, lose ANTE ak BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kaartu yi baare ak evaluated
  • Best 5-kaartu hand ci 7 kaartu (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets settled ci payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ñaare qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualify ak yow win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualify ak yow lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected ci dealer qualification
  • Yow win: Bet returned ak additional payout ci yow hand strength
  • Yow lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ñaare additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected ci dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Yow best hand ci Dealer's best hand
  • Yow win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Yow lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best ci Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 bu woon suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kaartu bu woon suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kaartu bu woon rank
  4. Full House: 3 kaartu bu woon rank + 2 kaartu bu woon rank
  5. Flush: 5 kaartu bu woon suit
  6. Straight: 5 kaartu bu woon
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kaartu bu woon rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs bu woon rank
  9. One Pair: 2 kaartu bu woon rank
  10. High Card: Highest kaartu wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] walla [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] walla [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] walla [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] walla [c]: Check (ñaare bet)
• [fold] walla [f]: Fold (baare hand)
• [skip] walla [s]: Skip ci next phase (bu ñaare action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high kaartu) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push bu dealer ñaare qualify
• BLIND bet can be very profitable ci strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch yow chip stack! Bu ci 0 walla ci suufu round, yow lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE ak BLIND bets are mandatory ci kókooroo buleen
• PLAY bets are optional ak strategic
• Make sure yow input ci correct action, ak only one action ci time.
